verdict: Ads are running, but leads aren't reaching anyone to close them.
narrative: In the last 28 days, your Google Ads delivered 16 recorded conversions on $1,687.76 in spend, but none of those leads are appearing in your intake system — conversion tracking is being repaired so that gap is fully visible and accounted for. More urgently, the intake seat vacant since early July means 49 new opportunities were created in your CRM this period with zero appointments booked; the ads are working, but inquiries have no one to receive them. Google Business Profile engagement also fell 61% week-over-week, which we're watching closely as it may reflect reduced local search activity or a data lag. Confirming your intake owner is the single action that unlocks the next stage of growth, and that milestone is targeted for August 31.
